scope: scripts/qualify_software_unit_changes.py on a frozen Debug build of 43749ff6 (artifacts/um6, git archive), 161/161 steps, in an owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 without safety units. All six software_unit_* kinds applied with checkpoint, PLC compile and save, exact snapshot diffs, typed refusals, fresh-Portal reopen and checkpoint restore; new: software_unit_create_from of an empty unit master copy (library_create_master_copy kind softwareUnit into the project library; the copy keeps namespace preset Ns.T and its SoftwareUnit relation; createdUnitMembers reports only the renamed default tag table) and software_unit_rename of an unreferenced unit; refusals DependencyExists (referenced unit), ObjectExists (name in use, template-name conflict with onNameConflict=refuse), InvalidRequest (current name, unknown policy), TargetIncompatible (block master copy). Boundary probe: a same-PLC copy of a unit holding FB UnitFb fails after the compile with MutationVerificationFailed (MasterCopyMode.Rename renamed UnitFb to UnitFb_1) and is restored from its checkpoint.
limitations: One owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 without safety units; master copies in the project library only, copies within the same PLC; global libraries, other PLCs or projects are not exercised.

V21 has no unit copy or move API; the copy route creates new objects and is not identity-preserving. A unit master copy describes only the unit, so renamed members are detected by TIA's <existing name>_<n> pattern, conservatively.
Engineering only; nothing is downloaded and runtime behavior is not observed.
